text:
maya: quick help — need an approver for PR #12894 (runtime config hotfix). It's a small change to the KV cache eviction threshold that unblocks a latency regression test. CODEOWNERS points to /infra/runtime and /eng-sre, but both leads are on rotation. Can someone proxy-approve so we can merge before the morning deploy?

jordan: can you paste the diff? if CI is green i'm fine to approve but want to eyeball.

maya: pasted below — it's basically a default tweak + comment. CI already ran: https://git.company/pr/12894

```diff
- kv_cache_eviction_ms: 12000
+ kv_cache_eviction_ms: 8000  # reduces KV churn during cold-starts
```

sam: from a safety POV this is fine. CI unit+integration passed, load tests are green in staging. No schema changes.

priya: pinging runtime leads — @alex @tessa can either of you OK this? we're on a tight window.

alex: I'm on pager duty and mostly heads-down until 10:30, not at my desk. If @jordan signs off and @tessa is okay, proxy is fine.

tessa: I'm available. Quick check — does this affect prefix caching TTLs or just eviction threshold?

maya: only eviction threshold; prefix/KV TTL unchanged. Verified none of the model-serving configs reference this key.

jordan: reviewed the diff, ran the local smoketest, no regressions. i'll approve and leave a short rationale. :+1:

sre-bot: CI: passed (unit, integration), deploy-check: ok, canary-required: false.

maya: added jordan's approval and a note in the PR. executing merge in ~2 mins unless objections.

jordan: no objections, go ahead.

maya: merged and kicked a deploy. thanks everyone! :tada:

tessa: thanks — watching canary logs. if anything spikes i'll open a rollback PR.

sam: nice, thanks for the quick turnaround.

Note: Thread was about who can proxy-approve CODEOWNERS-covered runtime config during rotations; consensus was a non-owner with explicit sign-off + passing CI is acceptable for small runtime hotfixes in the current on-call policy.
